data.one_liner: Adds Sentry logging integration for the Dart logging package
data.what_it_does: Integrates the Dart logging package with Sentry, sending log records as events. It registers a LoggingIntegration with the Sentry SDK to capture logs automatically.
use_when: You use the Dart logging package and want logs sent to Sentry
You need to monitor application logs in Sentry for debugging
avoid_when: You are not using the logging package or already have another logging integration
weaknesses: Only works with the logging package
No support for other logging frameworks
data.setup_notes: Add the package to pubspec, import, and call options.addIntegration(LoggingIntegration());
